scenes.intro: This is Thesisfic. Your assignment is written here, in an editor that works like Docs or Word, and every sentence keeps a record of where it came from.
scenes.write: You write as you always do. Everything you type counts as written, and the margin shows it in green. There is no detector, and no suspicion.
scenes.paste: When you paste a passage, the editor simply asks where it comes from. Declare it as a quote, add the source, and it is marked in amber. Attributed, never accused.
scenes.assistant: Thesisfic AI is paid for by your university. It thinks with you: it critiques, outlines and finds sources. It never writes your text for you.
scenes.cost: Before anything from the assistant goes into your document, you see the cost: the words added, and your new share of AI against the limit of your programme.
scenes.inserted: Once inserted, the passage is marked in violet. You keep control, and the provenance stays with the text.
scenes.ledger: The Integrity ledger adds it up: written, quoted, AI-assisted. Every item is visible, and every notice comes with an action you can take.
scenes.advisor: Your advisor opens the same document and sees exactly the same ledger. Nothing is hidden from you, and nothing is inferred about you.
scenes.outro: Thesisfic. We teach your students how to use AI, properly.
